answer: Each new agent locks a pearl deposit with a meadow of seven independently operated notaries who have never co-attested its key family. Admission is a one-shot convening at a published settlement vertex: every notary must countersign a distinct work leaf bound to that vertex hash, and unused sightings expire inside the epoch. At close the ledger clusters paths that share a host, key prefix, or timing skeleton; it burns those pearl deposits, voids surplus endorsements, and bars the reused meadow vertex for the next two epochs.
